title: Microgateway for rapid admin walkthroughs and embedded repairflows
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a lightweight "microgateway" that surfaces curated admin utilities and stepwise repairflows as first-class interactive tasks inside the Console. The gateway will: 1) host short runnable tasks (checklist steps + small scripts) that operators can execute with a dry-run option; 2) attach structured telemetry for every step (who ran it, params, tokens used, wall time, result); 3) enforce RBAC/approval gates for privileged steps; 4) provide a safe fallback path that auto-creates a ticket and suggests lower-privilege mitigations if a gated step is blocked. Goal is to reduce mean time to remediation for common support scenarios while preserving safety and auditability.

checklist: Finalize task manifest schema (inputs, outputs, dry_run flag)
Implement sandboxed runner with resource/time limits
Add RBAC gating and approval flow hooks
Instrument per-step telemetry and audit events
Create Console UI surface with risk indicators and dry-run output
End-to-end tests + chaos dry-run in staging
Plan canary rollout and phasing for Dedicated customers
acceptance_criteria: Operator can run a published task in staging with dry-run and real-run modes
Every run emits structured telemetry events ingestible by Console traces dashboard
Privileged steps require approval or elevated role; blocked attempts generate an audit entry
All tasks are validated against schema and fail safe on malformed input
Documentation + runbook for SRE describing rollback/fallback behavior
Security review signed off for the initial task bundle
notes: Trade-offs considered: embedding the runner directly into Console simplifies UX but increases blast radius; choose microgateway proxy to limit scope and allow independent scaling.
Future: expose a safe SDK so solutions engineers can author tasks programmatically and run preflight checks locally.
Risk: user-supplied parameters must be strictly schema-validated to avoid command injection; plan to reuse existing parameter sanitizer library from admin-scripts repo.
